defects.what: Concentric rings run behind the headline and dominate the upper half, weakening the text-first hierarchy.
Scattered background speckles intrude into text and resemble stray marks.
Cream lettering on coral has weaker contrast than the otherwise strong text palette.

VAHU.craft_notes: Cohesive warm palette and wave motif across sizes, with purposeful narrow banners; steam-in-disc motif reads ambiguously as a heater icon and feels overdecorated at larger sizes. Exact copy, dimensions and story text-safe area met.
VAHU.revision_notes: Correct new headline in all six and Spiced honey cortado in the four product-bearing sizes; optional product line remains omitted in narrow formats. Facebook product line wraps and date/CTA move down; story product line rebreaks. Motif and palette preserved, though square headline now crowds the ring.

defects.what: Long single-line product copy is considerably smaller than surrounding logistics and loses phone readability.
Large gap between sun and brand text leaves a weakly used upper band.

WGJQ.craft_notes: Clean warm serif typography, excellent contrast and coherent calm coastal waves; layouts adapt to all six shapes and small banners stay legible. Motif is generic but restrained; exact copy and story safe zones satisfied.
WGJQ.revision_notes: Both requested copy changes correct across applicable files. Most layout stable; square sun moves upward/right despite request being text-only, and headline sizes/rebreaks adjust to fit. Product line remains appropriately omitted in the two smallest formats.

pairwise_round1.why: WGJQ's calmer composition and stronger text contrast avoid VAHU's distracting rings, speckles and low-contrast CTA.
